tools.name: one_rep_max
tools.description: Estimate a one-rep max (1RM) from a set of weight × reps, with a percentage table and the load each rep count should allow. Epley by default, Brzycki optional. Estimates above 10 reps are flagged as less reliable.

tools.name: rpe_estimate_max
tools.description: Estimate a one-rep max from weight, reps and RPE, treating RPE as reps in reserve (RPE 8 = 2 reps left) and applying the one-rep max formula to reps + reps in reserve.

tools.name: rpe_target_load
tools.description: Find the load for a set of a given number of reps at a target RPE, from a known or estimated one-rep max. Rounded to the nearest 0.5.

tools.name: plate_loading
tools.description: Work out which plates to put on each side of a barbell to reach a target weight, using standard gym plates or the plates you list. Reports the exact load and anything your plates can’t make.

tools.name: warmup_sets
tools.description: Build a warm-up ramp to a working weight: plate-friendly jumps, reps falling from 10 to singles, with the plates for each set. The same ramp the IronLedger app suggests.

tools.name: powerlifting_score
tools.description: Score a powerlifting total (or a bench press) against bodyweight with DOTS, IPF GL points and the original Wilks, using the coefficients the OpenPowerlifting rankings use.

tools.name: check_program_file
tools.description: Check a training program written as a CSV or TSV file exactly as the IronLedger app will import it, before anyone loads it on a phone. Returns the weeks, sessions and exercises it creates, every skipped row and warning with its row number, the exercise names the app will question ("Did you mean ...?
